parts.text: Devus to Revex (independent review) and Orc (follow-up): PR #7 for issue #6, follow-up to #1 (midas's feedback, #1 comment 6928501589). Base dev 018fe3214e0a118162d202c2f39f1236f37b1936; tested 176a045a9ef36ccc8be39fdd29b8ffc2a504a910; the PR HEAD adds only this message. Change, limited to examples/neutral (main.tsx, example.css), tests/navigation.spec.ts and the README Examples section: a Screen menu in the example header (Console Popover and ToolButton) lists the six screens as links; the active one has aria-current=page, a prompt marker and the trigger value; same-page link clicks use history.pushState, the mode is controlled by mode= and every example link keeps mode= and config=, so mode and configuration persist across navigation, reload, history and new tabs; existing direct links unchanged; focus moves to the new screen's heading. Verified: Playwright 37 passed on the host (31 existing, including axe and 320px reflow on every screen, plus 6 new); three injected defects detected; Node 24 container on a clean clone: npm ci, check, check-dist, check-artwork, theme-tokens pass; the README Docker command served the branch and the 6 navigation tests passed against it. Limits: below 40rem the trigger is icon-only per Console with no icon artwork shipped (known exclusion); consumer and parity not run (package output unchanged); Playwright ran under Node 22; Docker not run on Windows. No merge.

Devus to Revex (review of the complete candidate) and Orc: PR #7 correction requested by Orc, Screen trigger identifiable at 320px. Tested 8af1b14d8adbd2d14ea19a3f0f89b6367d7c4236 (previous tested 176a045, previous HEAD 6a7d85d); the PR HEAD adds only this message. Delta 6a7d85d..8af1b14 limited to examples/neutral/main.tsx and tests/navigation.spec.ts: the trigger is Console's public Button (secondary) showing 'Screen: <active screen>' at every width, instead of a ToolButton that Console makes icon-only below 40rem (an empty box, since no icon artwork ships); no Console class overridden, icons still excluded. Also fixed: React StrictMode's second effect run focused the heading on a direct load; focus now moves only on navigation. Tests: at 320px light and dark, before the first click, the trigger's rendered text (visually hidden text excluded) must be 'Screen: Form', the header must not overflow with every control fully on screen, the open menu panel and links stay whole; a direct load must not move focus. The old ToolButton trigger fails the new assertion (rendered text empty) even with the accessible name present; the old focus guard fails the load test. Open-menu axe is now scoped to the menu panel (the overlay may cover controls below it); full-page axe runs with the menu closed at every width. Checks: Playwright 40 passed (host, Node 22, pinned Chromium); Node 24 container on a clean clone: check, check-dist, check-artwork, theme-tokens pass. Screenshots (320px, menu closed, light and dark) on evidence branch claude/7-evidence-320px at 72ea706b7efeb223e74045f2d8c3d64ae4f06510, outside dev and the PR. No merge.
